# Avomeal

Avomeal is a South Florida food, prepared-meal and party-box brand created by VNV Events. It focuses on meal preps, holiday menus, party boxes, appetizers, sweets, dinner kits, individual food products and subscription-friendly ordering.

## Main Food Services

- Meal preps
- Holiday menus
- Party boxes
- Appetizers
- Sweets and dessert trays
- Dinner kits
- Individual prepared food products
- Subscription-friendly meal ordering
- Event food support connected to VNV Events
- Configurable minimum order applies at checkout

## Main Public Pages

- Home: https://vnvevents.com/
- VNV Gourmet (previously /avomeal): https://vnvevents.com/vnv-gourmet/
- Store: https://vnvevents.com/store/
- Meal Plans: https://vnvevents.com/meal-plans/
- Product Categories: https://vnvevents.com/store-categories/
- Contact / Quote: https://vnvevents.com/contact/

## Main Food Areas

- South Florida
